module_summary: Deserializes a PTP time-distribution serial stream, syncs words into clk domain via toggle CDC, stores ToD/offset banks, and converts relative timestamps to ToD by adding offsets and selecting the in-range result.

anchors.name: ptp_td_sdi
anchors.why: Serial time-distribution input carrying ToD and offset words.

anchors.name: td_shift_reg
anchors.why: 16-bit deserializer shift register assembling serial TD words.

anchors.name: bit_cnt_reg
anchors.why: Bit counter framing each 16-bit word after start bit.

anchors.name: td_valid_reg
anchors.why: Marks a word in progress; triggers word capture when counter expires.

anchors.name: td_index_reg
anchors.why: Word index within a TD message, reset on idle.

anchors.name: td_msg_reg
anchors.why: Message type latched from word 0, forms upper word id.

anchors.name: td_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Captured deserialized word held for clock-domain crossing.

anchors.name: td_tid_reg
anchors.why: Word id {msg,index} accompanying captured word across CDC.

anchors.name: td_sync_reg
anchors.why: Toggle flag signaling a new word to clk domain.

anchors.name: dst_td_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: clk-domain word valid pulse from toggle edge detect; enables field updates.

anchors.name: dst_td_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Synchronized TD word written into ToD/offset registers.

anchors.name: dst_td_tid_reg
anchors.why: Synchronized word id decoded to select which field slice to write.

anchors.name: ts_sel_reg
anchors.why: Selects which bank (0/1) receives current vs alternate ToD values.

anchors.name: ts_tod_s_0_reg
anchors.why: ToD seconds bank 0; selected into output seconds.

anchors.name: ts_tod_offset_ns_0_reg
anchors.why: Nanosecond offset bank 0 added to relative timestamp.

anchors.name: ts_tod_ns_0
anchors.why: Relative ns plus offset 0; range-checked to choose output ToD.

anchors.name: input_ts_rel
anchors.why: Relative timestamp input to be converted to ToD.

anchors.name: input_ts_valid
anchors.why: Input timestamp valid, registered into output valid.

anchors.name: input_ts_tag
anchors.why: Timestamp tag passed through to output.

anchors.name: output_ts_tod
anchors.why: Converted ToD timestamp {s, ns, fns} output.

anchors.name: output_ts_valid
anchors.why: Output timestamp valid pulse from output register.

anchors.name: output_ts_tag
anchors.why: Registered tag accompanying converted timestamp.

groups.name: TD deserializer
groups.description: Pipelines serial TD input, shifts in 16-bit words, tags them with message/index id.

groups.name: Toggle CDC
groups.description: Toggle synchronizer moving TD words and ids from ptp_clk to clk.

groups.name: ToD register banks
groups.description: Two ToD seconds/ns-offset banks written by decoded TD words, swapped by ts_sel_reg.

groups.name: Timestamp conversion
groups.description: Adds both offsets to relative ns, picks in-range result, registers ToD output.
